transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?

Honestly, I've been struggling with my temper lately. For the past two weeks, I've been having these sudden, uncontrollable explosions of anger over the smallest, most trivial things. I just feel constantly irritated and snap for no real reason.
During these past two weeks, have you also had a period of feeling unusually energized or euphoric, needing much less sleep than usual, talking more than normal, or doing risky things?

No, I haven't felt energized or happy at all. It's actually been the complete opposite—I feel constantly tense, irritable, and on edge. I definitely haven't experienced anything like euphoria or needing less sleep.
Have you been feeling worried or anxious most days, and finding it hard to control those worries?
No, I wouldn't say I feel worried or anxious in that way. It's not really about having anxious thoughts or worrying about the future. I just feel extremely tense, on edge, and angry most of the time.
Did these symptoms start after a specific stressful event or major life change, such as a breakup, job problem, loss, or conflict?
I'm really not sure. I can't pinpoint any specific stressful event or major life change that would have triggered this. It feels like it just started happening out of nowhere.
Over these past two weeks, have you also been feeling down, hopeless, or lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

No, I wouldn't say I feel down, hopeless, or like I've lost interest in things. It's more that I am constantly on edge and angry all the time. My nerves are just so sharp that I feel ready to explode at any moment.
Even if it doesn't feel obvious, have there been any recent stressors or changes in your life at work, home, school, or in relationships around the time this started?

No, I really can't think of any specific changes or stressors at work or home that would explain this. Everything has been pretty much the same as usual. It honestly feels like this anger and tension just started out of nowhere.
Have these symptoms caused problems at work, at home, or in your relationships, or made it hard to function normally?

I'm not entirely sure, and I haven't really thought about how it has impacted my functioning specifically. But the constant anger and tension definitely make getting through daily life really difficult.
Have these symptoms caused problems at work, at home, or in your relationships, or made it hard to function normally?

I haven't really thought about how it's affecting my work or relationships, to be honest. I'm just so overwhelmed by this constant, heavy tension and anger every single day. It's taking up all my energy just trying to deal with how I feel.
Have you noticed any specific worries or fears that keep coming back, even if they aren't about one particular event?
I'm not really sure about that. I haven't noticed any specific recurring worries or fears keeping me up. It's more just that general, constant feeling of being extremely tense and angry all the time.
Did these symptoms start after a specific stressful event or major life change, such as a breakup, job problem, loss, or conflict?
I'm really not sure if a specific event triggered all of this. But I do know that these symptoms have been happening constantly for about two weeks now.
